title: 30-Day Abs Challenge
rules: Complete the daily ab workout for 30 consecutive days.

title: Running Streak
rules: Run at least 1km every day for 20 days.

title: Flexibility Flow
rules: Stretch for 15 minutes daily for 15 days.
benefits: Increased flexibility and reduced injury risk.

title: Fat Burn Blast
rules: Complete a 20-minute HIIT fat-burn session every day for 28 days.
benefits: Increased calorie burn and improved metabolism.

title: Hyrox Prep Challenge
rules: Follow the hybrid strength + endurance program 5 days a week for 6 weeks.
benefits: Race-ready strength, speed, and functional endurance.

title: Calisthenics Mastery
rules: Practice bodyweight skill progressions (push-ups, pull-ups, dips) daily for 35 days.
benefits: Improved bodyweight strength, control, and muscle definition.

title: Yoga Discipline
rules: Complete a 25-minute yoga flow every day for 21 days.
benefits: Improved balance, mindfulness, and full-body flexibility.

title: Push-Up Progression
rules: Increase daily push-up reps following a progressive plan for 30 days.

title: Jump Rope Cardio Blitz
rules: Jump rope for 10 minutes daily for 14 days.
benefits: Improved coordination, endurance, and calorie burn.
